name: services/crstests/course_test

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • Primary:

    • course_edition - Course edition that test is defined for.

      This field references objects returned by services/courses/course_edition2 method. See its returns section for possible subfields (only primary are allowed).

    • is_limited_to_groups - boolean - true if test is for some selected groups only;

    • class_groups - If is_limited_to_groups is true this field contains list of groups.

      This field references objects returned by services/groups/class_group method. See its returns section for possible subfields (only primary are allowed).

  • Secondary:

    • root - Root node of a test.

      This field references objects returned by node2 method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

result_fields.name: course_edition
result_fields.description: Course edition that test is defined for

result_fields.name: is_limited_to_groups
result_fields.description: boolean - true if test is for some selected groups only

result_fields.name: class_groups
result_fields.description: If is_limited_to_groups is true this field contains list of groups
